title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-01-02
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT (x) > CDR (x) > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a legendary era, highlighted by an epic Dark Star and stellar St Stephen, The Eleven and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is crystal‑clear – a superb soundboard mix that puts the cymbals and snare right up front, with only minor tape hiss and a brief cut in St Stephen. Musically it’s a showcase performance: Dark Star is repeatedly called one of the best ever, followed by a fiery St Stephen, an enthusiastic Eleven and a rousing Lovelight. Even though the set is truncated, the energy and improvisational depth make it a must‑listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 20 reviews uniformly praise both the performance (especially Dark Star) and the audio quality; only minor technical flaws and the partial nature of the show keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with front‑forward cymbals, snare and organ; occasional tape hiss and a short cut in St Stephen, but overall superb fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial show (Dark Star → St Stephen → The Eleven → Lovelight) retains a powerful arc despite missing the rest of the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers highlight Jerry's melodic phrasing and soaring tone, especially in the later minutes of Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ (and possible Tom Constanten) is singled out as a rare audible highlight on Lovelight and Dark Star; discussions compare Pigpen vs. Constanten sound.
band_member_comments.Drums: Cymbals, snare and overall drum presence are praised for being upfront and punchy.
